visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark curly hair and spectacles sits at a blue desk, wearing a white and black striped shirt. He opens a black leather wallet, peers inside with a disappointed facial expression, and sighs. The background shows a cluttered home office with a guitar and storage shelves. (2) The scene cuts to an office where another man in a grey t-shirt is sitting at a computer. The curly-haired man approaches and speaks to him; the man in grey turns his head, and math-related text graphics overlay the frame. (3) Back at his home desk, the man scrolls through job recruitment websites on a large computer monitor. He looks focused and points at the screen. (4) A quick montage sequence follows: the man wears a red tracksuit while pushing a green lawnmower on a bright outdoor lawn; he uses a digital tablet to draw a simple cartoon portrait of a woman; he holds a metal water bottle and brushes a microphone in a studio setting. (5) He sits at his desk and his phone vibrates on the table. He picks it up, eyes widening and mouth agape in a shocked expression as he looks at the screen. (6) Vibrant, fast-paced gameplay footage of an anime-style action RPG is shown, featuring characters with swords and magic, producing flashy purple and blue particle effects. (7) Finally, the man holds his phone up to the lens to show the game screen, smiling and speaking with high energy. He sits in his studio with awards visible on the shelf behind him.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a male voice speaking in a melancholic, slightly frustrated tone at a moderate pace. A soft, gentle acoustic guitar melody plays in the background, providing a warm but sad texture. (2) A sharp 'Hard cut' transition leads to a brief dialogue between two male voices in an office setting with low ambient room tone. (3) Loud, percussive mechanical keyboard typing sounds occur, followed by a 'thud' as the protagonist reacts. (4) A sequence of diverse SFX plays: the loud mechanical roar of a lawnmower, the sharp scratch of a digital pen on a screen, and soft, close-up ASMR brushing sounds over the microphone. (5) A high-pitched digital UI chime and a haptic vibration buzz trigger a shift. The music transitions abruptly into a high-energy EDM track with a strong 4/4 beat and bright synthesizer leads. (6) Rapid-fire combat sound effects—swishes, metallic clangs, and synthesized explosions—overlap with the fast music. (7) The narrator's voice becomes highly energized and loud, with a bright, enthusiastic tone, peaking in pitch as he invites the audience to join the game, accompanied by the driving electronic beat until the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a relatable and humorous skit about a struggling content creator looking for a job to capture the viewer's attention. It then seamlessly transitions into an advertisement for the mobile game 'Endless Dreamworld' (無盡夢迴), highlighting its diverse gameplay modes, visual style, and relaxing qualities as the perfect solution to life's stresses.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The protagonist directly holds the phone showing the game, talks about its features, and includes a clear call to action for the audience to join.
